body:
Adds `research/grid-twin` (README, white paper, 11 tests, reproducible experiments), its README bullet and `site/projects.json` entry. `python site/build.py` prints ok (180 projects).

Headline results (all from `experiments/results.txt`): 8-connected grid/Euclid length ratio has mean 8(√2−1)/π = 1.0548 and max 1.0824 at 22.5°, independent of cell size; route rankings can flip with map orientation. Free space only; stylised.
